description: This file defines functions and types for managing and summarizing channel statuses, accounts, and credentials in a plugin-based system. It includes functions for inspecting accounts, summarizing sources, handling credential tokens, and building a status table for channels.

methods.name: summarizeSources
methods.description: Aggregates and summarizes a list of source strings, counting duplicates and creating a label and parts array.

methods.name: existsSyncMaybe
methods.description: Checks if a given file path exists, returning null if path is empty or an error occurs.

methods.name: formatTokenHint
methods.description: Formats a token string into a hint, optionally showing secrets or a hashed prefix.

methods.name: inspectChannelAccount
methods.description: Inspects a channel account, either via plugin config or by reading account details.

methods.name: resolveChannelAccountRow
methods.description: Resolves and constructs a ChannelAccountRow with account info, enabled/configured status, and snapshot.

methods.name: formatAccountLabel
methods.description: Creates a label for an account, including its name if available.

methods.name: buildAccountNotes
methods.description: Generates notes for an account based on its snapshot and configuration.

methods.name: resolveLinkFields
methods.description: Extracts link status, authentication age, and self E164 from a summary object.

methods.name: collectMissingPaths
methods.description: Checks accounts for missing file paths and returns a list of missing paths.

methods.name: summarizeTokenConfig
methods.description: Analyzes account tokens and credentials, returning a status and detail message.

methods.name: buildChannelsTable
methods.description: Builds a table of channel statuses, including rows and detailed account info, for the 'status --all' command.
